natural_body: 40% discounts raise acquisition and revenue but hurt retention and renewals.

first.rationale: Current data shows both onboarding completion (-4% QoQ) and activation (-6% QoQ) declining. Memory 86 and 31 directly address onboarding friction and have demonstrated durable lift in activation and adoption without retention harm. Verifying these two will confirm the baseline effect sizes and implementation details. Simplify_onboarding is the highest-leverage play because: (1) it targets both observed problems simultaneously, (2) it has the strongest historical support in our memory (two independent confirmations), (3) unlike promotional_pricing it avoids the retention damage documented in memory_73, (4) it serves SMBs being targeted by competitor pricing without discounting, and (5) it builds on memory_91 (activation messaging) which can amplify gains. Enterprise_sales_assist is valuable but orthogonal to the activation/onboarding declines. Referral_incentive works best on stable bases (memory_57 notes established customers), not during acquisition pressure. A standard experiment scope is appropriate: focused enough to complete in one week, broad enough to validate effect in current market conditions.
